title: Data reachable by people who should not reach it
for: A bucket, share, repository or export that was public or over-shared.

steps.title: Remove the public or over-broad access
steps.why: Every minute it stays open is more to account for.
steps.undo: Restore the previous access setting, if closing it broke something that depended on it.

steps.title: Export the access logs for the whole period it was open before they age out
steps.why: Whether anybody read it is the question every later decision turns on, and logs expire.

steps.title: Establish when it became reachable
steps.why: The period is what the access logs are read against.

steps.title: Read the access logs for anything that was not yours
steps.why: Open and unread, and open and downloaded, are different incidents.

steps.title: List what was in it, and whether any of it is personal or secret
steps.why: This decides who has to be told.

steps.title: Rotate any credential or key that was in it
steps.why: A secret that was readable is a secret somebody may hold.

steps.title: Decide, on the incident, whether a breach has likely occurred
steps.why: Likely, not confirmed: the seventy-two hours run from here.

steps.title: Search for other places with the same setting
steps.why: The template that made this one made others.
